description: Hand-verifiable fixtures for the shared forecast core. modelForward pins the TinyMLP forward pass and occlusion attributions; features pins extractFeatures against scripted ring feeds; escalation pins stepEscalation band/event/latch semantics. Regenerated by the training pipeline only for modelForward parity cases — the formulas here are documented so a reviewer can recompute every number.

modelForward.description: TinyMLP 18->12->1 forward pass. mean[k]=k/20, scale[k]=0.5, W1[j][k]=((3j+2k)%7-3)/10, b1[j]=((j%4)-1.5)/10, W2[j]=((2j%5)-2)/8, b2=0.05, Platt a=1.25 b=-0.15. hidden_j=tanh(b1[j]+sum_k W1[j][k]*(x[k]-mean[k])/scale[k]); logit=b2+sum_j W2[j]*hidden_j; rawRisk=sigmoid(a*logit+b). attribution_i = rawRisk(x) - rawRisk(x with encoded[i] set to mean[i]).

features.description: Each tick i (1-based) is one wall second at ts = sessionStartTs + i*1000: apply focus snapshots in order, then desk, then decision status, then commit(ts). focus tuples are [processName, windowTitle, matchedAllow, matchedBlock]; desk tuples are [label, confidence, webcamEnabled]. expected.values are the 18 encoded features in FORECAST_FEATURE_KEYS order.

escalation.description: stepEscalation sequences. Step i runs at ts = t0 + i*1000 with ready:true unless overridden. expected lists band, effectiveFuseSec(state, settings) and the exact events emitted by that step.
